title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 07
desc: Who truly has your back—your boyfriend or your best friend? ?? In this episode of Delhi vs Mumbai, we put relationships to the ultimate test! From loyalty checks to emotional dilemmas, watch as Delhi and Mumbai episode 7 to prove whose squad reigns supreme.

title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 08
desc: When your partner cheats on you, the signs can be subtle or right in your face—but are they real, or just overthinking? A sudden change in behaviour, secretive texts, and those mysterious "work calls" at odd hours—are you reading too much between the lines or just ignoring the signs?

title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 09
desc: Ex ki waapsi is always when you’ve finally moved on. The memories resurface, the what-ifs linger… but will you turn the page or reopen the book? Is it fate giving you another chance, or just a test to see if you’ve really moved on?

title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 10
desc: Holi with Girlfriend is nothing short of magical—colours in the air, laughter in every splash, and love in every stolen glance. As you chase each other with vibrant hues, the world fades, leaving just the two of you in a whirlwind of playful mischief and stolen kisses. Amidst the chaos of colours, one thing is certain—her smile is the brightest shade of happiness.

title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 11
desc: When your girlfriend wants to pay, it’s a true test of modern love—are you chivalrous enough to insist, or progressive enough to accept? The debate begins: Is it about equality, or does footing the bill define a gentleman? The waiter awkwardly stands by as you both exchange glances, waiting to see who taps the card first. In the end, is love about splitting everything equally, or about knowing when to let the other person win?

title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 12
desc: Ruhaani from Mumbai travels to Delhi to meet Chirag’s family—who also happens to be her boyfriend. As she navigates the warmth and chaos of Delhi's culture, she uncovers surprising truths about his family, their expectations, and where she truly stands in his life.

title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 13
desc: In Episode 13, Ruhani’s lavish surprise for Chirag collides with his secret plan to move back to Delhi for his mother and a major opportunity, leading to an emotional confrontation that tests their love and leaves both with a bittersweet, unsent goodbye.

title: Delhi Vs Mumbai S1 Ep 14
desc: In the gripping final episode of Delhi vs Mumbai, emotions run high as Chirag (Abhishek Kapoor) and Ruhani (Malhaar Rathod) face the ultimate test of love. With tough decisions about career, family, and their future together, will distance and city-based differences pull them apart — or will love triumph over all?

desc: Dude depicts the life of a detective, scrambling to hunt down the answers behind a baffling case. It reels him into twisted relationships filled with perplexing events. And the more he tries to untangle the truth, the more convoluted it becomes.

title: Emergency Room Ep 01
desc: In a busy hospital, Trisha faces a tough night when an accident victim is rushed into the emergency ward. As she works to save his life, the victim’s panicked father lashes out at her, demanding faster treatment. But Trisha stays calm, knowing that fear often comes out as anger.

title: Emergency Room Ep 02
desc: Trisha steps up when it matters most. When a man begins to choke and the situation turns critical, Trisha doesn’t hesitate. With calm precision and unmatched courage, she performs a high-stakes procedure all on her own. What happens next is nothing short of remarkable. Her quick thinking and skill become the difference between life and death. Watch how one nurse turns pressure into action.

title: Emergency Room Ep 03
desc: Trisha decides to take a long leave from the hospital to spend much-needed time with her family. Just as she steps away, the hospital is hit with a major emergency. Without hesitation, Trisha returns to duty, putting others before herself and becoming a true hero in a time of crisis. Watch this heartfelt story of courage, sacrifice, and the dilemma between duty and family.

title: Mohalle Wala Pyaar Ep 01
desc: n Harshil’s mohalla, love arrives every Diwali — bright, sparkly… but never quite complete Every year he promises himself — this time I’ll confess! But between mithai, fireworks and nerves… he ends up saying, “maybe next Diwali.” This year, he’s all set to confess his love to his Diwali wali dost — but will she say yes? Or will a new twist steal the spotlight?

title: Mohalle Wala Pyaar Ep 02
desc: In Harshil’s mohalla, love has finally met its competition. After years of dancing through every Diwali together, Anamika now takes the floor with Vishal — and suddenly, it’s not just a performance, it’s personal.

title: Mohalle Wala Pyaar Ep 03
desc: Harshil ke chehre pe muskaan kam aur dard zyada nazar aa raha hai — kyunki ab Anamika aur Vishal ki “perfect jodi” ek "forever jodi" banne jaa rahi hai. Par iss kahani mein sab kuch utna simple nahi jitna lagta hai — Vishal ne bhi dekh liya hai wo bond… wo Mohalle Wala Pyaar Kya usse lagega kuch gadbad hai? Kya Anamika samajh payegi kya chubh raha hai Harshil ko? Aur kya iss Diwali… ek dil tootega ya do dil judenge?

title: Mohalle Wala Pyaar Ep 04
desc: This Diwali, not just diyas — hearts are breaking too Vishal’s jealousy has sparked a storm, and Harshil’s world just fell apart. One Ghargula shattered… but along with it, so did a bond built over years. Will Anamika see the truth before it’s too late?

title: Mohalle Wala Pyaar Ep 05
desc: The fights. The silence. The misunderstandings. It all comes down to this night. As the mohalla lights up for Diwali, two hearts are still trying to find their way back to each other. Will Harshil and Anamika finally find their way back… or lose each other forever?

title: Office Dancers Ep 01
desc: Episode 1 of Office Dancers takes you inside the world of three ordinary office-goers with one extraordinary secret — they are the dancing stars no one sees coming. By day, they’re buried in emails, meetings, and deadlines. By night, they’re chasing rhythm, passion, and dreams that refuse to stay hidden. This is where their journey begins — full of chaos, comedy, and courage.

title: Office Dancers Ep 02
desc: Our three office rebels are back — and the chaos only gets bigger. Between never-ending deadlines, secret rehearsals, and the constant fear of getting caught… will their double life survive another day? ?? This episode is a reminder that sometimes the smallest victories — a dance step nailed, a dream defended, a smile shared — are the ones that keep us alive in the middle of all the madness.

title: Office Dancers Ep 03
desc: The helmets are still on, but the stakes just got higher. Our office dancers are juggling tighter deadlines, tougher bosses, and an even bigger risk of exposure. In this episode, friendships are tested, rivalries heat up, and every beat brings them closer to the truth. Because sometimes the hardest battle isn’t with the world outside — it’s with the fear inside.

title: Office Dancers Ep 04
desc: An anonymous email lands in the inbox.With the threat ticking, our office dancers scramble to lock their alibis, juggle brutal deadlines, and figure out who’s watching. Trust wobbles, secrets leak, and every rehearsal feels like a trap. Will the masks stay on—or is this the episode their identities finally crack?
